tools.name: assess_domain
tools.description: Start a fresh public email-security check of one domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, DANE, DNSSEC, MX and BIMI). Use this when there is no stored result yet or you need an up-to-date one; to read an existing result, call get_result instead. It returns only a queue confirmation, not the repor

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Return the latest stored public report for one domain: score from 0 to 100, profile (mail, null_mx or no_mx), per-protocol findings, and Remediation.packs with the DNS records to publish. BIMI is reported but does not change the score. Use this to read a report or to poll after assess_domain; use ge

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Return totals for every domain in the public SecLens.ONE corpus, plus a list of those domains with their latest score, newest first. "stats" holds the domain count, average score, score bands and per-protocol present and effective counts. "results" holds one row per domain (Domain, Score, Generated,

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: assess_domain · Private data: get_result · Public sink: assess_domain, get_result.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: assess_domain · Private data: get_result · Public sink: assess_domain, get_result

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
